Literal Markdown punctuation is escaped while converted emphasis and code stay formatted

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"content\":{\"escape_asterisks\":true,\"escape_misc\":true,\"extract_metadata\":false},\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.Markdown!.Content);
```
